legend.lane: A dataset family inside one source. A lane REFINES its source: the effective permission is the intersection of the source's display_policy and the lane's own surface flags. A lane can never widen a source.
legend.commercial_verdict: clear | review | hold | license_required | rejected | do_not_use
legend.public_allowed: may appear on the unauthenticated surface
legend.pro_allowed: may appear behind the paid surface
legend.internal_allowed: may be read by internal callers at all
legend.ingest_allowed: false = the adapter must refuse the endpoint and delete the field before canonical persistence. Not a display rule.
legend.model_use_allowed: may be used for feature engineering or model training
legend.prohibited_model_uses: named model purposes this lane may never serve, even when model_use_allowed is true
legend.origin_state: documented | inferred | undocumented | contradicted — what we know about where the SOURCE got it
legend.verification: V = read in the governing primary document; S = secondary; U = unverified
legend.sampling_bias: null, or a named bias that makes absence uninterpretable

notes: Every CFBD lane below is DESIGN ONLY. No CFBD data has been ingested and no key exists.
A lane with ingest_allowed=false is stronger than a display rule: the value must never reach canonical storage, including inside a JSON column.

lanes.dataset_family: games, results, schedules, calendar, records, head-to-head matchups
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: thin facts; 1869+ predates any known feed
lanes.obligations: Never present as official NCAA, conference or school data (CFBD terms §5). No bulk export, no mirror.
lanes.notes: CFBD documents no origin for results before 2001.

lanes.dataset_family: head coaches, coach seasons, coaching tenures
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: names and tenures are thin facts
lanes.obligations: Never present as official data.
lanes.notes: 1886+ coverage exceeds any identified feed; CFBD curates identity itself.

lanes.dataset_family: venues and stadium attributes
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: elevation and timezone are CFBD enrichment
lanes.obligations: Exclude every provider logo, image and media field (CFBD terms §8).
lanes.notes: Base venue list origin undocumented; geo-enrichment is CFBD's own.

lanes.dataset_family: Elo, SRS, PPA, WEPA, CORE, win probability
lanes.governing_basis: CFBD methodology: "PPA, win probability, WEPA, Elo, SRS, and CORE are proprietary CFBD models."
lanes.obligations: Individual values only, as part of a larger product. No bulk table, no mirror, no feed, no substitute API, and never proxied as our own API product. These values are API Data, not our Derived Outputs.
lanes.notes: SP+ and FPI are deliberately NOT in this lane: CFBD attributes both to third parties.

lanes.dataset_family: team season and team game statistics, advanced team stats
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: ESPN-shaped underneath; public raw rows prohibited
lanes.obligations: No raw rows on the public surface and no API mirror. Aggregates reach the public surface only as derived output with its own lineage.

lanes.dataset_family: drive records
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §2.4: ESPN gamepackage evidence
lanes.obligations: Raw rows are internal only. Derived outputs may reach Pro through the derived layer, never by relabelling a raw row.

lanes.dataset_family: play-by-play, play stats, enriched passing and rushing
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §2.4: cfb-api live.service.js reads gamepackageJSON; cfb-api-v2 types.ts carries onWatchESPN, sportscenter, dataSourceIdentifier
lanes.obligations: Raw rows are internal only. Model training is the safest use; published rows are the least safe.
lanes.notes: Strongest ESPN evidence of any lane.

lanes.dataset_family: team and player box scores, advanced box scores
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: ESPN-shaped, 2004+
lanes.obligations: Raw rows are internal only.

lanes.dataset_family: player season and player game statistics, success rates
lanes.obligations: Raw rows are internal only; derived output only beyond that.

lanes.dataset_family: player usage, returning production
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: derived by CFBD from the play lane, and inherits its exposure
lanes.obligations: Raw rows are internal only.

lanes.dataset_family: college rosters
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: CFBD terms §8 covers player names and likenesses
lanes.obligations: Text facts only. No source photograph, image or media field. The API contract does not settle name or likeness rights.

lanes.dataset_family: NFL draft selections as listed by CFBD
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: draft results are widely republished facts; the pre-draft evaluation fields are not
lanes.obligations: No downloadable or raw draft table sourced from CFBD. The preDraft* fields belong to the pre_draft_evaluation lane and must never be ingested with these rows.

lanes.dataset_family: transfer portal entries: origin, destination, date only
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: the movement fact is separable from the rating attached to it
lanes.obligations: Only origin, destination and transfer date. rating and stars belong to transfer_portal_ratings and must be deleted before persistence. Portal rows carry no athlete id, so they can only be joined by name — which the identity rules forbid.

lanes.dataset_family: collegeAthleteId, nflAthleteId, recruitIds, CFBD team and athlete ids
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: a crosswalk table is definitionally "a standalone dataset" under CFBD terms §5; §9 disclaims identifier stability
lanes.obligations: INTERNAL ONLY, hard. No crosswalk endpoint, no join table download, and never the public canonical id. Reconciliation key only.
lanes.notes: Ids are almost certainly ESPN's (inferred, unverified).

lanes.dataset_family: high-school, JUCO and prep recruit rankings, ratings, stars, team recruiting rankings, position-group ratings
lanes.governing_basis: 247Sports: "The 247Sports Composite is a proprietary algorithm"; CBSi terms bar commercial use and building a business on the Content
lanes.obligations: Do not ingest. Do not store. Do not train on.
lanes.notes: Field shape matches the 247 Composite; CFBD names 247 for talent but not for recruiting.

lanes.dataset_family: team talent composite
lanes.governing_basis: CFBD OpenAPI /talent: "Returns 247Sports Team Talent Composite ratings for a season."
lanes.obligations: Do not ingest.
lanes.notes: CFBD names the third party itself.

lanes.dataset_family: SP+ team and conference ratings
lanes.governing_basis: CFBD /sp/trends: "SP+ is a rating system created by Bill Connelly" (linking @ESPN_BillC)
lanes.obligations: Do not ingest.
lanes.notes: Absent from CFBD's own list of proprietary CFBD models.

lanes.dataset_family: Football Power Index
lanes.governing_basis: CFBD data-availability: "FPI is third-party data"; CFBD's C# client docs: "/ratings/fpi - ESPN's Football Power Index"
lanes.obligations: Do not ingest.

lanes.dataset_family: betting lines, against-the-spread records
lanes.governing_basis: Sportsbook-branded prices (Caesars, Bovada, DraftKings, William Hill, SugarHouse, teamrankings, numberfire); DraftKings terms bar automated collection and commercial exploitation
lanes.obligations: Do not ingest. We already hold a licensed odds path.

lanes.dataset_family: preDraftGrade, preDraftRanking, preDraftPositionRanking
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: editorial scouting opinion, near-certainly an ESPN draft board
lanes.obligations: Delete the fields before canonical persistence. They arrive inside the draft_picks payload and must not survive it.
lanes.notes: The least factual and most copyrightable content in the API.

lanes.dataset_family: transfer portal rating and stars
lanes.governing_basis: D3 §3: star ratings imply a 247/On3 composite; On3 terms bar commercial use without written consent
lanes.obligations: Delete rating and stars before canonical persistence. They arrive inside the portal payload.

lanes.dataset_family: leagues, franchises, team identities, venues, championships, professional head coaches
lanes.governing_basis: Wikidata:Licensing: "All structured data in the main, property and lexeme namespaces is made available under the Creative Commons CC0 License"

lanes.dataset_family: player to college association (P69 educated at, P54 member of sports team), college programmes, conferences, college coaches
lanes.governing_basis: CC0. D3 §4 measurement: 49,088 American football player items, 38,235 (78%) with a college link; the PFR-to-SRCFB bridge is only 2,968 players
lanes.obligations: Wikidata holds items for people notable enough to have one, which over-represents players who reached professional football. Absence is not a negative label. This lane may not supply the denominator for any selection-outcome model until a source representing the whole college player population exists.
lanes.notes: The licence is clean; the SAMPLE is not. These are different objections and both bind.

lanes.dataset_family: external identifier properties (P3561 PFR, P9338 NFL.com, P3686 ESPN, P3697 SRCFB player, P8761 SRCFB school, P8762/P8777 NCAA statistics)
lanes.governing_basis: CC0 as data. D5: a proprietary identifier is never our public canonical id
lanes.obligations: The identifier VALUES are CC0 and may be stored, but they name third-party systems, so they stay internal and are reconciliation keys only.
lanes.notes: Holding a PFR id is not permission to hold PFR data.

lanes.dataset_family: which institutions fielded a football programme in which survey year, and the squad size reported
lanes.governing_basis: ope.ed.gov: "This database consists of athletics data that are submitted annually as required by the Equity in Athletics Disclosure Act (EADA)" — US federal agency publication; no licence text is printed on the page, so the public-domain status is INFERRED
lanes.obligations: Store the survey year and provenance on every derived relationship. Institutions self-report, so a row is what the institution stated, not an audited fact.
lanes.notes: Narrow lane by design. Any other EADA field fails closed: there is no lane for it, so it cannot be persisted.
